answer: The fable cap is policed at intake and ripple exposes the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a glacier tag. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, as every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
